method: Image review of the ui-shell-smoke.mjs captures from main 1bca776 against read-only production data, read as full-resolution crops. It follows the e751df8 review kept alongside as e751df8-visual-review.json. The only UI change between the two runs is PR #324's table cell rule, so this review concentrates on the pages that render markdown and on the DOCV-1 links; every other route passed its checks in this baseline with no axe violations, no overflow and no client errors.

observations: The captured document is TL-ENG-R001_report.md, the report from the research mission run in this session.
Its 5-column Options Comparison Table renders whole words in every cell: 'GitHub Actions billing and runner pricing', 'Low: no migration', 'Low-medium: per-language YAML'.
Columns past the third are clipped at the region's right edge, which is the sideways scrolling the fix restores; the page itself does not overflow.
Before #324 a table of this shape broke words every one to three letters.
The same layout in the dark theme; cell text, headers and borders stay legible on the dark surfaces.
At 1440 px all five columns fit without scrolling, so the fix left the desktop layout alone.
The reader opens on the Text tab with Overview, Chunks and Evidence beside it.
One 'Open report' link sits under 'Captured 9/13/2026, 6:59:19 PM · DeepSearch', which is America/Chicago time.
Provenance lists the session, the capturing mission ('Captured by this mission') and its report ('Result of the capturing mission').

limitations: Mission results render behind the Results tab, which is local state with no URL parameter, so no capture shows a mission's result table. The shared renderer is covered by the 390 px browser test and by this document page.
Settings captures are kept out of the repository because they show the signed-in account's email; their SHA-256 hashes are recorded in withheld-screenshots.json.
